gloss: right to run for office; eligibility for election

definitions.gloss: right to run for office; eligibility for election; passive suffrage
definitions.explanation: The legal right to stand as a candidate in an election. In Japan, the minimum age for this right varies by office: 25 for the House of Representatives and local assemblies, 30 for the House of Councillors and prefectural governors.

examples.japanese: {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}は25{歳|さい}からだ。
examples.english: The right to run for office starts at age 25.

examples.japanese: {参議院議員|さんぎいんぎいん}の{被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}は30{歳以上|さいいじょう}と{定|さだ}められている。
examples.english: The eligibility to run for the House of Councillors is set at age 30 or older.

examples.japanese: {選挙権|せんきょけん}が18{歳|さい}に{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げられたのに{対|たい}し、{被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}の{年齢|ねんれい}はまだ{変|か}わっていない。
examples.english: While the voting age was lowered to 18, the age requirement for the right to run for office still hasn't changed.

notes:
Compound of {被|ひ} (passive; receiving) + {選挙|せんきょ} (election) + {権|けん} (right). Literally the right to "be elected," contrasting with {選挙権|せんきょけん}, the right to vote ("to elect"). The {被|ひ} prefix marks the passive side of the election process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}を{持|も}つ: to have the right to run for office
- {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}の{年齢|ねんれい}: age of eligibility for candidacy
- {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}を{失|うしな}う: to lose eligibility to run for office
- {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}の{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ: lowering of candidacy age

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {選挙権|せんきょけん}: right to vote, active suffrage
- {参政権|さんせいけん}: political rights, the broader concept encompassing both voting and candidacy
- {公民権|こうみんけん}: civil rights
